label: A bucket of an object store
description: One bucket of an object store speaking the S3 API, where the tree's blobs are kept when project.json → blobs.connection names a connection of this kind. Every object is keyed <prefix>/<run id>/<uuid>, so the key says which run put it; a handle whose id is not of that form opens nothing. The credentials are secrets; the rest are facts about this one bucket.

endpoint.description: the URL the store answers at, e.g. http://minio.wilanis.svc:9000

region.description: the region the store signs requests for; MinIO answers any, and us-east-1 is its default

bucket.description: the bucket the blobs are kept in; it must exist, since the plugin never creates one

prefix.description: the key every object starts with, so one bucket can hold several trees' blobs, e.g. customers/uploads. Absent: objects sit at the root of the bucket

accessKeyId.description: the access key the requests are signed with, read as {{secrets.*}}

secretAccessKey.description: the secret that goes with the access key, read as {{secrets.*}}

forcePathStyle.description: true: address the bucket as <endpoint>/<bucket> rather than <bucket>.<endpoint>, which MinIO and most stores that are not AWS need. Absent: true
